bullets.text: Gummidipoondi traders intercepted a highway department vehicle over roadside vending issues, and the office should monitor local tensions and ensure smooth vendor relations.
L&T performed the groundbreaking ceremony for its 52 MW AI-ready data center in Chennai through Vyoma.AI, and the ministry should track infrastructure progress.
Noida Authority approved the development of an AI City and business park alongside an IT land scheme, and the department should study this model for state initiatives.

stories.title: Noida AI City Plan Gets Authority Board Approval
takeaways: Noida Authority approved plans for developing an AI City-cum-business park and an integrated automobile complex.
This marks a competitive national development in AI infrastructure that policymakers in Tamil Nadu should monitor.
